administering_agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development (MOALD)

pricing.price_basis: Statutory subsidised price payable in person at the NCPB depot counter.
pricing.statutory_notice: KES 2,500 per 50kg bag is the statutory subsidised price gazetted under MOALD Circular 2026/02. This figure is published for planning purposes only. CASH IS NOT ACCEPTED AT THE DEPOT - pay to the NCPB till number displayed at the depot or deposit at the bank the depot manager names (NCPB Operating Circular 4B, Section 5.1). Kilimo Hakika does not process payments, collect funds, hold money or connect to any mobile money service. Payment is made by the farmer directly to NCPB and receipted by NCPB.

allocation.rounding_rationale: Entitlement is floored to whole bags. Fertilizer is issued only in sealed 50kg bags, and flooring prevents over-allocation of a capped public subsidy.
allocation.basis: 2 bags for planting plus 2 bags for top-dressing per declared acre, i.e. 4 bags per acre, subject to the per-farmer ceiling.
allocation.cap_note: The 100-bag ceiling is reached at 25.0 declared acres. Acreage above 25 acres does not increase the entitlement.
allocation.min_acreage_note: A declared acreage below 0.25 acres does not attract a whole bag and cannot be served under this circular.

required_documents.label: Original National ID
required_documents.description: The original Kenyan National Identity Card of the registered farmer. Presented at the depot counter for verification.

required_documents.label: KIAMIS E-Voucher SMS Code
required_documents.description: The valid, unexpired e-voucher code issued by SMS following KIAMIS farmer registration.

required_documents.label: Signed Ward Agricultural Officer (WAO) Form
required_documents.description: The scheme application form countersigned by the Ward Agricultural Officer for the farmer's declared ward.

conditional_documents.label: Official Chief's Stamped Lease Agreement
conditional_documents.description: Where the declared land is leased rather than owned, an official lease agreement bearing the Area Chief's stamp is mandatory.
conditional_documents.required_when_description: Required only when the farmer declares the land as leased.

rejection_criteria.label: Photocopy of National ID presented instead of the original
rejection_criteria.reason: NCPB depot clerks are barred from accepting photocopies of the National ID. Only the original document is accepted at the counter.

rejection_criteria.label: Expired KIAMIS e-voucher
rejection_criteria.reason: An e-voucher past its validity window is void and cannot be redeemed. A fresh voucher must be requested through KIAMIS before travelling.

rejection_criteria.label: Unstamped lease agreement on leased land
rejection_criteria.reason: A lease agreement without the Area Chief's official stamp is not accepted as proof of cultivation rights on leased land.

compliance.agronomic_advice_notice: Kilimo Hakika does not provide crop, soil, seed or fertilizer recommendations of any kind. It reports statutory entitlement, mandatory paperwork and NCPB depot readiness only. Agronomic guidance must be obtained from your Ward Agricultural Officer.
compliance.payments_notice: No financial transactions are performed. No mobile money, card or banking integration exists in this service. All published figures are statutory prices only.
compliance.marketplace_notice: No buying, selling, bidding or third-party vendor listings. Only gazetted Government (NCPB) depots are listed.
compliance.declared_crop_usage: The declared crop is used solely to confirm that the holding falls inside the gazetted scope of this circular. It never generates an agronomic recommendation, and no alternative crop is ever suggested.

gazetted_crop_scope.basis: MOALD Circular 2026/02, Schedule 1 (Eligible Food and Industrial Crops)
gazetted_crop_scope.note: A crop outside Schedule 1 is outside the statutory scope of this subsidy. This is a scope-of-entitlement fact recorded in the circular, not agronomic advice.

payment_at_depot.headline: Zero cash accepted at the depot
payment_at_depot.notice: Cash is NOT accepted at any NCPB depot counter. Pay to the NCPB till number displayed at the depot, or deposit at the bank the depot manager names, and carry the receipt. Bring a phone able to complete the transfer. Kilimo Hakika does not process, hold or move any money - you pay NCPB directly and NCPB receipts you.
accepted_means: NCPB till number displayed at the depot
Bank deposit slip from the bank named by the depot manager
payment_at_depot.verbatim_extract: Cash payments at the depot shall NOT be accepted.
